key_facts: WttParser: pure function, no dependencies, parses VTT strings to SubtitleTrack
VideoService: depends on VideoRepository and YtdlpExecutor (injected)
SubtitleService: depends on SubtitleRepository, VideoService, SubtitleParser, YtdlpExecutor
Zod schemas in packages/shared/src/schemas/ for request/response validation
AppError thrown by VideoService and SubtitleService with ErrorCategory and code
call_chains: SubtitleService.extractForVideo -> videoService.findById -> subtitleRepository.findByVideoId -> ytdlpExecutor.getSubtitles -> subtitleParser.parse -> subtitleRepository.createMany
